description: This is a Spring Boot configuration class that sets up global Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) policies for the backend service. It defines allowed origins, methods, headers, and exposed headers, and registers a CorsFilter bean to apply these settings across all API endpoints.

classes.name: CorsConfig
classes.description: Spring configuration class that defines and registers a global CORS filter, configuring allowed origins, methods, headers, and exposed headers for the backend API.

methods.name: corsFilter
methods.description: Creates and returns a CorsFilter bean that enforces the specified CORS policies across all endpoints.
